basis: The named 55-leaf Linux V11 workload includes Volicord A-to-B-to-C Work continuity and eight B/C Analysis Snapshots. Its independent regression ceilings are 15 minutes total duration and 512 MiB post-warmup analysis growth. These values are retained as acceptance criteria for this workload, not inferred from the older 54-leaf workload. A clean-HEAD focused rehearsal of the 55-leaf workload measured 836,349.979 ms and 525,260,967 bytes after the analysis-storage optimization; the authoritative gate must still measure and qualify its exact candidate. The 4 GiB RSS, 2 GiB manifest and logical storage, 2.125 GiB physical storage, 90-second RPC, and 2,048-byte-per-graph-item ceilings remain unchanged. The original 48-file storage fixture measured 691,245 logical bytes and 332,517 bytes of unchanged growth after normalization, compared with 1,656,908 and 828,454 bytes before it; these regression checks remain in force.
